title: Future retirement plans – A1 English Reading Test

seo.title: Future retirement plans – A1 English Reading Test - Test-English
seo.description: A1 English reading test about future plans. Practise 'be going to' and 'would' like with a simple text and comprehension questions.

parts:
A1 English Reading Test

Read the messages from four people about their retirement plans. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer. In some questions, you need to choose TWO answers.

Future retirement plans

Maria, 62

I am going to retire next year, and I am very happy about it. I want to spend more time with my family because my children live in another city. I’m going to visit them very often, and I hope I will see my grandchildren every week. I would also like to learn how to cook better because I never have time now. When I retire, I think my life will be more relaxed.

George, 65

After I retire, I would like to travel. My wife and I love going to new places, so we are going to visit different countries in Europe. We are going to start with Italy because we have friends there. I hope the weather will be good because we want to walk a lot and see old towns and museums. Travelling will definitely be a lot of fun when we don’t have to work.

Linda, 60

I’m not going to travel very much after I retire. I like staying at home, so I’d like to enjoy my free time there. I have a small garden, and I love working in it. I’m going to grow fruit and vegetables. I’d like to cook with vegetables from my garden. I also hope I will have more time to read books and watch films.

Ahmed, 63

I love my job and being active, so when I retire, I’d like to stay busy doing different things. I’m going to spend more time exercising to stay healthy, and I’m going to help at the sports centre in my town. I also love playing the guitar, but I’m very bad at it because I don’t have time now, so I’m going to take lessons and practise more.

Questions

questions.prompt: Who would like to learn something new?
Who would like to stay at home?
Who is going to spend time with their family?
Who is going to take care of plants?
Who wants to stay busy after retirement?
